an3.127:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an3.127:1.2: athakho hatthako devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā
an3.127:1.3: bhagavato purato ṭhassāmīti osīdati saṃsīdati na sakkoti saṇṭhātuṃ
an3.127:1.4: seyyathāpi nāma sappi vā telaṃ vā vālikāya āsittaṃ osīdati saṃsīdati na saṇṭhāti
an3.127:1.6: bhagavato purato ṭhassāmīti osīdati saṃsīdati na sakkoti saṇṭhātuṃ.
an3.127:2.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho hatthako devaputto bhagavato paṭissuṇitvā oḷārikaṃ attabhāvaṃ abhinimminitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
an3.127:2.4: ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho hatthakaṃ devaputtaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an3.127:3.1: ye te hatthaka dhammā pubbe manussabhūtassa pavattino ahesuṃ apinu te te dhammā etarahi pavattinoti
an3.127:3.2: ye ca me bhante dhammā pubbe manussabhūtassa pavattino ahesuṃ te ca me dhammā etarahi pavattino
an3.127:3.3: ye ca me bhante dhammā pubbe manussabhūtassa nappavattino ahesuṃ te ca me dhammā etarahi pavattino
an3.127:3.4: seyyathāpi bhante bhagavā etarahi ākiṇṇo viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi
an3.127:3.5: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante ākiṇṇo viharāmi devaputtehi
an3.127:3.6: dūratopi bhante devaputtā āgacchanti hatthakassa devaputtassa santike dhammaṃ sossāmāti
an3.127:3.7: tiṇṇāhaṃ bhante dhammānaṃ atitto appaṭivāṇo kālakato
an3.127:3.9: bhagavato ahaṃ bhante dassanassa atitto appaṭivāṇo kālakato
an3.127:3.11: saṃghassāhaṃ bhante upaṭṭhānassa atitto appaṭivāṇo kālakato
an3.127:3.12: imesaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ atitto appaṭivāṇo kālakatoti.
